scenes.name: DISTANCE ADDRESSES
lines: Imagine a map with three routes joining the same two junctions. Two routes have three roads each; the third has ten.
想象一张地图：三个路线连接同一对路口。两条各有三段路，另一条有十段。
Choose two landmarks. Every junction now has a pair of shortest walking distances. Here, all fifteen pairs are different.
选两个地标，每个路口便有一对最短步行距离。这里，十五对距离全部不同。
Two landmarks locate everyone. A single landmark can distinguish every vertex only on a path; this branching map is not a path.
两个地标能定位所有人。只有整张图是一条路径时，单个地标才可能区分所有顶点；这张分岔的地图不是路径。

scenes.name: NUMBER PATTERNS
lines: Now put numbers on the map. The Laplacian subtracts neighboring numbers from the degree times the local number. The signless rule adds them instead.
再给路口放上数。拉普拉斯规则用度数乘本地数，再减去邻居数之和；无符号规则则改成相加。
This pattern scales by one under the subtracting rule, and by three under the adding rule. An eigenvalue is that scaling factor.
画面中的数值模式，在相减规则下放大一倍，在相加规则下放大三倍。这个倍数就是特征值。
Multiplicity counts independent patterns sharing a factor. It does not mean the size of the largest factor.
重数计算共享同一倍数的独立模式有多少个，并不是最大倍数有多大。

scenes.name: WHY SIX STEPS
lines: The two short routes can exchange places. Split patterns into those unchanged by this exchange, and those that reverse sign.
两条短路线可以交换。数值模式可分成两种：交换后保持不变，或交换后整体变号。
Along a route, a recurrence determines the next number from the previous two. At the relevant candidate values, these numbers repeat after six steps.
沿着路线，只需前两个数就能递推下一个数。在关键的候选特征值处，这些数每六步重复。
The endpoint equations make two independent patterns meet for the subtracting rule, while the adding rule keeps every eigenvalue simple in this family.
端点方程使相减规则的两种独立模式共享特征值；而在这族图中，相加规则的各特征值都是单重。

scenes.name: AN INFINITE FAMILY
lines: Use a long route of six k plus four roads, for any positive integer k. The number of landmarks stays two.
令长路线有六乘 k 加四段路，其中 k 为任意正整数。所需地标数始终是二。
The largest multiplicity is two for the Laplacian and one for the signless Laplacian. Exactly one matches the landmark count.
拉普拉斯的最大重数是二，无符号拉普拉斯的最大重数是一。恰好只有前者等于地标数。
These graphs have no twin vertices. Their growing numbers of junctions give infinitely many different examples.
这些图没有孪生顶点，路口数量不断增长，因此得到无穷多个不同的例子。

scenes.name: THE QUESTION AND ITS SOURCES
lines: The question comes from Alfuraidan, Khan, and Sauras Altuzarra. The distance argument builds on the metric classification by Knor, Sedlar, and Shkrekovski.
问题由 Alfuraidan、Khan 与 Sauras-Altuzarra 提出；距离部分依托 Knor、Sedlar 与 Škrekovski 的度量分类。
Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang give the spectral extension. Read the full story for the proof, small exceptions, and the exact scope already available in Lean.
Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 给出了谱论拓展。完整故事解释证明、小规模例外，以及 Lean 中已有的精确范围。
Remaining formalization requests are public. Contributors can help turn the written arguments into reusable checked mathematics.
尚待形式化的任务已公开。欢迎参与，把书面论证变成可以复用、由计算机核验的数学。
